messages.text: Our crew and ship survive, both contracts are complete, and the repaired beacon stands at two. Communities four reflects both commercial distribution and Vigil's protection. Guild discretion has met its actual duty; I want NG retained. I also recognise the army accepted readiness three and supplied protection voluntarily. That makes joint military government credible to me, rather than proving an obligation to withdraw Vigil Home would be wise.

reason: I prefer MJ because both Security delegates agreed the useful operations and can scrutinise future costs together. I remain opposed to MA's permanent service terms. MI is a possible fallback if joint authority cannot win agreement: the crown coordinated responsibly. I will examine a complete package explicitly; no signature follows from these preferences.
